lines.speaker: Sazed
lines.text: Mistress. I have not slept, forgive my appearance. The logbook is nearly translated, and it troubles me more with every page.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: It's his journal. The Lord Ruler's. From before he took the throne.

lines.speaker: Sazed
lines.text: So we assumed. But the man who wrote this doubts himself on every page. He writes of a packman who hates him, and of a duty he does not want. It is not the voice of the one who sits in Kredik Shaw.

lines.speaker: Sazed
lines.text: And there is Feruchemy in these margins, Mistress. Storing strength, storing health, storing years — in metal worn against the skin. If the Lord Ruler is a Feruchemist as well as an Allomancer, then his metalminds would be the most guarded objects in the empire.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Then we find out what he wears, and never takes off.
